heading: Section 7.04. Reports by Trustee.
snippet: The Trustee shall furnish to the Issuer and the Borrower, not later than thirty (30) days after the end of each Bond Year, a statement of all funds and accounts held under this Indenture.

heading: Section 7.06. Notice of Default.
snippet: The Trustee shall give notice to the Bondholders of any Event of Default known to the Trustee within thirty (30) days after the Trustee obtains knowledge thereof, unless such default has been cured.
